meta.title: Gusty — Good ideas deserve to move
meta.description: Gusty helps you turn an idea into a real project, one small step at a time — with the funding, people and tools to make it happen.

home.headline: Good ideas deserve to move.
home.lead: Tell Gusty about your idea. Gusty helps you understand it, shape it and take the next small step towards the funding, people and tools that make it happen.
home.ideaHint: Write it however it comes to you. A few words is enough.

steps.title: Describe it
steps.body: In your own words, as messy as you like.

steps.title: See it understood
steps.body: Gusty reflects your idea back clearly. You stay in control and can change anything.

steps.title: Take a small step
steps.body: Up to three next steps, with the most useful one first. Never a wall of tasks.

home.ideaPrivacy: Your idea is saved privately. No account needed: you can add your email later to keep it on any device.
home.ideaUnavailable: Saving ideas isn't switched on in this version yet, so nothing you type here is stored.

ideaErrors.empty: Write a few words about your idea first.
ideaErrors.tooLong: That's a lot of words! Please keep it under 5,000 characters for now.
ideaErrors.unavailable: Saving isn't available right now. Your text is still here; please try again later.
ideaErrors.failed: Something went wrong while saving. Your text is still here; please try again.

explore.title: Explore
explore.body: Funding, people, opportunities, events and organisations that fit your project. We're building this carefully, with real, verified sources, so it isn't switched on yet.

connections.title: Connections
connections.body: Collaborators, communities and networks that can help your project grow. This comes after Explore.

footer.tagline: People, ideas, places for a brighter tomorrow.

notFound.title: This page wandered off.
notFound.body: Let's get you back somewhere useful.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.intro: Your ideas, saved as you go. Pick up wherever you left off.
projects.empty: No projects yet. Every project starts with a few words.
projects.ideaHint: Change anything. Gusty saves as you type.

save.failed: Couldn't save. Your text is still here; we'll try again when you next type.

projects.notFound: We couldn't find that project. It may belong to another account or browser.
projects.signedOutBody: Projects are private to you. Enter the email you used and we'll send you a sign-in link.
projects.keepBody: Right now your projects are saved in this browser only. Add your email and we'll send a link that keeps them safe and lets you open them on any device.
projects.signInFailed: That sign-in link didn't work. It may have expired or already been used. Please ask for a new one.

emailLink.label: Email address
emailLink.sent: Check your inbox. We've sent you a link. You can close this page; your work is saved.

errors.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address. Please check it.
errors.unavailable: Email sign-in isn't available right now. Please try again later.
errors.failed: We couldn't send the link. Please try again in a minute.

interpretation.title: Here's what I understood
interpretation.intro: Check this and change anything that isn't right. Your words always win.
interpretation.reading: Gusty is reading your idea. This usually takes a few seconds.
interpretation.demoNotice: Demo mode: this is not a real AI reading yet. It only repeats your first sentence and asks general questions. Gusty's real reading switches on once the AI key is set up.

actions.addPlaceholder: Type it in your own words
actions.refreshNote: Your own words and anything you've confirmed stay as they are.

interpretation.questionsNote: Questions to think about when you're ready. No need to answer them now.

errors.declined: Gusty couldn't read this one. Your idea is saved and you can keep working on it.
errors.invalid: Gusty's reading came back incomplete. Please try again.
errors.error: Something went wrong. Your idea is saved. Please try again.
errors.limit: You've reached today's limit for readings. It resets within a day.
